brand_identity.name: Roots & Earth
brand_identity.description: Premium fresh-food and grocery e-commerce platform targeting South African customers. Artisan farm-to-table feel with a dark earthy palette.

spacing_and_layout.product_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 sm:gap-8

hero_carousel.layout: Full width or large bento grid spanning 12 cols, height around 70vh
hero_carousel.animation: Smooth fade or slide for the banners using Framer Motion

product_card.surface: Solid #1C1E1B with 1px border #2D302A, no drop shadow. Focus on high-quality image
product_card.hover_effect: Slight lift -translate-y-1, border changes to primary or accent color
product_card.badges: Absolute top-2 left-2 for discount/stock, using Accent (Terracotta) for urgent/sale
product_card.wishlist_icon: Absolute top-2 right-2, iconoir-react or lucide-react

sidebar_navigation.surface: bg-[#131412] or transparent if on layout

hero_banners.description: Butternut squash, onion, and zucchini on a wooden surface.
A colorful collection of heirloom tomatoes on a dark background.
Hands slicing a fresh carrot on a wooden table outdoors.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Lucide-React or Phosphor Icons for category icons.
Ensure the hero slider uses actual text layered over the image using the provided bg-gradient-to-r overlay to ensure readability.
Implement the UI exclusively using Tailwind CSS and raw HTML tags or highly customized Shadcn components.
The currency is ZAR (R), so format prices as 'R 50.00'.
Do not use generic Inter font. Apply the Cormorant Garamond for headings and Outfit for body.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements for testing.
Build out the responsive slide-in cart and checkout flow with location-based suggestions.
Implement an admin dashboard section with analytics and product management.
Use high contrast ratios for text visibility against the dark backgrounds.
